Evaluate specialized

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Use PostgreSQL (or your default).
Defer decision for 6 months.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The default answer should be:
'We will use PostgreSQL and revisit this
decision in 6 months when we have data.'
Most teams revisit and find they never
needed a different database.
